title: Digital receivable supplement processing failed
description: Emitted as the contract_digital_receivable_supplement_processed_failure event type when a contract update or termination cannot be applied to the digital receivable supplement of a contract (Brazil-only), currently when the contract has no supplement. One event is emitted per failed contract operation and carries the business error code. Update failures echo the requested supplement values, while termination failures carry only contract identifiers, document numbers and the error.

contract_id.title: Contract ID
contract_id.description: Pismo-generated identifier of the contract from the originating command. Absent when the command carries no contract.

contract_operation_id.title: Contract operation ID
contract_operation_id.description: Operation identifier of the contract from the originating command, as informed when the contract was created.

total_amount.title: Total amount
total_amount.description: Requested total amount of the supplement in BRL with decimals, taken from the contract update command. Absent on termination failures.

available_balance.title: Available balance
available_balance.description: Requested available balance of the supplement in BRL with decimals, taken from the contract update command. Absent on termination failures.

start_date.title: Start date
start_date.description: Requested start date of the supplement period, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd. Absent on termination failures.

end_date.title: End date
end_date.description: Requested end date of the supplement period, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd. Absent on termination failures.

min_expire_days.title: Minimum expire days
min_expire_days.description: Requested minimum number of days until maturity that a digital receivable must have to be covered by the supplement. Absent on termination failures.

max_expire_days.title: Maximum expire days
max_expire_days.description: Requested maximum number of days until maturity that a digital receivable may have to be covered by the supplement. Absent on termination failures.

min_face_value.title: Minimum face value
min_face_value.description: Requested minimum face value in BRL with decimals that a digital receivable must have to be covered by the supplement. Absent on termination failures.

max_face_value.title: Maximum face value
max_face_value.description: Requested maximum face value in BRL with decimals that a digital receivable may have to be covered by the supplement. Absent on termination failures.

debtors.title: Debtors
debtors.description: Debtors requested in the contract update command to be included in or excluded from the supplement scope. Absent when the list is empty and on termination failures.

document_number.title: Debtor document number
document_number.description: Document number of the debtor, either CPF or CNPJ, as informed on the contract update.

document_number_prefix.title: Debtor document number prefix
document_number_prefix.description: First eight digits (CNPJ root) of the debtor document number. Present only when the debtor is identified by CNPJ; absent for CPF debtors.

operation_type.title: Debtor operation type
operation_type.description: Whether the debtor is part of the supplement scope, validated against the debtor OperationType enum on the contract API. INCL: The debtor is included in the supplement scope. EXCL: The debtor is excluded from the supplement scope.

lender_document_number.title: Lender document number
lender_document_number.description: Document number (CPF or CNPJ) of the lender, taken from the contract of the originating command.

creditor_document_number.title: Creditor document number
creditor_document_number.description: Document number of the contract creditor, taken from the contract of the originating command.

error_code.title: Error code
error_code.description: Legacy business error code returned by the API explaining why the operation failed, defined in StatusCodeError. Current flows emit 106011 (digital receivable supplement not found); other codes of the same dictionary include 108011 (contract not found) and 101103 (inactive contract cannot be applied).

error_details.title: Error details
error_details.description: Structured error with the new 6-digit error code and its description. Present only when the legacy error_code has an equivalent in the new error dictionary; absent otherwise.

code.title: Error code (new format)
code.description: Error code from the new error dictionary, 6 digits in the [MM][O][nnn] format (module, operation and sequence).

description.title: Error description
description.description: Human-readable description of the error in the new error dictionary.

feature_type.title: Feature type
feature_type.description: Domain operation that triggered the event, taken from the originating contract command. CREATE_CONTRACT: Contract creation. UPDATE_CONTRACT: Contract update, including inclusion, change, exclusion and renegotiation. DELETE_CONTRACT: Contract termination. CREATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: Negotiable instrument act creation. UPDATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: Negotiable instrument act update. DELETE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: Negotiable instrument act termination.

operation_type.title: Operation type
operation_type.description: Specialization of feature_type, serialized from the OperationType enum. Contract flows use UPDATE_CONTRACT_INCL, UPDATE_CONTRACT_ALTE or UPDATE_CONTRACT_EXCL on update, and CANCELLATION_ERROR, CLOSING, CLOSING_DJUD or CLOSING_RNGC on termination according to the termination reason.
